Description.description:
`## Description` -- the set's own introductory free markdown. Mandatory, opaque.

A field-less `MarkdownSection2` leaf: any markdown (paragraphs, lists,
quotes, fenced code, nested H3 to H6 headings) is accepted verbatim and
round-trips byte-for-byte -- the parser captures the section's complete
extent without structural interpretation (the engine's field-less
leaf-case rule, the SYSRS `SystemPurpose`/SOP `Purpose` free-form-prose
precedent and the TXT opaque-body precedent).
Description.title: Description

Items.description:
`## Items` -- the flat bullet list of bundled artifacts, in any mix of the 12 reference tags.
Mandatory, at least one item.

Parameters
----------
items:
    Bullet list of `<TAG> <uuid-or-feat-id>: <title>` cross-references
    from the shared 12-tag reference vocabulary (the eleven UUID tags
    plus `FEAT`), any mix, each optionally followed by an indented notes
    paragraph (the `MarkdownListItemWithNotes` shape SYSRS uses). Must
    contain at least one item.

items.description: Bullet list of `<TAG> <uuid-or-feat-id>: <title>` cross-references from the shared 12-tag reference vocabulary (any mix); must contain at least one item.
items.title: Items

Items.title: Items

MarkdownListItemWithNotes.description:
One list item that captures continuation paragraphs (loose-list notes) via a declared `notes` field.

Mirrors `ExtensionItem`'s docstring: adds `notes` for captured continuation
paragraphs inside a list item, so they appear in ``model_dump()``/JSON output
instead of being lost to Pydantic's private-attribute invisibility. Delegates
``get_extent()`` / ``from_text()`` / ``__str__()`` to the inherited
``MarkdownListItem`` (no new extent logic needed; ``MarkdownStr.process_list_field()``
iterates items by ``get_extent()`` and the field-distribution loop picks up
remaining text).
MarkdownListItemWithNotes.title: MarkdownListItemWithNotes

MarkdownParagraph.description:
A markdown paragraph ("p"), the non-heading sibling of `MarkdownSection`.

A paragraph has no level, so there is a single `MarkdownParagraph` class
(no `MarkdownParagraph1`..`6` spectrum) and no `@alias` check -- a
paragraph's content is free-form prose, not a title.

Leaf (no declared nested fields): `_value` holds the paragraph's own line
span, verbatim. Composite (declares fields): `_value` holds only the
paragraph's own inline text (e.g. a lead-in sentence); the remaining text
is delegated to nested field parsing, bounded by the next heading of any
level (a paragraph can never itself contain a heading). See
`get_extent`/`from_text`/`__str__` docstrings below for the full
mechanics.
MarkdownParagraph.title: MarkdownParagraph

Set.description:
The `set` body: a single H1 section with a mandatory opaque `## Description` and a mandatory
`## Items` list.

The H1 heading text is free-form. Deliberately a plain
`MarkdownSection1` (no root comment field): a set document's fixed
sections start directly under the H1.

Parameters
----------
description:
    `## Description` (opaque free markdown). Mandatory.
items:
    `## Items` (>=1 mixed-tag `<TAG> <id>: <title>` bullet, optional
    per-bullet notes). Mandatory; last section.

items.description: `## Items` section (>=1 mixed-tag bullet). Mandatory; last.

Set.title: Set

SetFrontmatter.description:
Set (SET) frontmatter: `MarkdownFrontmatter` narrowed for the ``set`` document type.

Parameters
----------
type:
    Fixed discriminator, always ``"set"``. Narrows the base's mandatory,
    default-less ``str`` field to a ``Literal["set"] = "set"``, so a document
    omitting ``type`` entirely still parses as a set document.
status:
    One of ``"draft"``, ``"progress"``, ``"done"``, ``"review"``. Narrows
    the base's free-form ``str = "draft"`` default to this closed
    four-value set. Blank/absent still defaults to ``"draft"`` (inherited
    from the base's ``_default_blank_status_to_draft`` validator, which
    runs before this one).
version:
    The ``models.md`` schema major.minor.patch version this document's
    frontmatter was written with. DO NOT CHANGE!

All other fields (``id``, ``created``, ``updated``, ``version``,
``classification``) are inherited unchanged from
:class:`MarkdownFrontmatter`.
SetFrontmatter.title: SetFrontmatter

description:
A full set document: YAML frontmatter and body.

Attributes
----------
frontmatter:
    The YAML frontmatter block. See :class:`SetFrontmatter`.
body:
    The parsed set sections. See :class:`Set`.
title: SetDocument
